<!--

===============================================================================

SAM Framework

Operational Playbook Template

===============================================================================



Purpose

-------

Use this template to document repeatable operational procedures.



A Playbook answers one question:



"How should this task be performed?"



Playbooks describe operational execution.



They do NOT define architecture.



They do NOT define governance.



They do NOT explain research.



If an operation cannot be executed from this document alone,

the Playbook is incomplete.



See:



\- EXECUTION\_MODEL.md

\- REVIEW\_PROCESS.md

\- INCIDENT\_TEMPLATE.md

\- KNOWLEDGE\_TEMPLATE.md



===============================================================================

\-->
